title: A New Song
program_note:
The text for A New Song is drawn from the compilation of Psalm texts on page 162 of the Gates of Prayer.

The setting is for amateur SATB congregational choir, with optional Soprano or Tenor soloist, and with optional keyboard accompaniment.  The soloist may be a choir member, or may be a cantor or cantorial soloist.  The keyboard may be either piano or organ.  If organ is chosen, the stops should be chosen with care:  as the piece is highly rhythmic, a clear, fast speaking stop should predominate, alternating with softer, more gentle stops in the Dolce sections.  If the work is performed with organ but without soloist, those lines in the accompaniment which double the solo part should be played on a brighter, more strident solo stop; if it is performed with a soloist, however, care should be taken that the choice of stops do not cover the solo line.
